settings.account.description: How you appear to other people on your network.
settings.account.handleConfirm.title: Change your handle?
settings.account.handleConfirm.descripti: Your backup branch will change from {{from}} to {{to}}. Existing backups stay on the old branch.
settings.appearance.description: Light or dark, the theme and the language.
settings.backup.description: Copy your agents, workflows and settings to a git remote, so you can restore them or use them on another computer.
settings.cloud.description: Accounts Nandi uses for cloud models and for agents’ AWS access. Agents never see these keys: they get short-lived access limited to what their settings allow.
settings.cloud.usedFor: Used for Bedrock models (Runtimes) and agents’ AWS calls such as S3 (Internet access).
settings.cloud.signIn: Sign-in for Bedrock models and agents
settings.cloud.signInHint: Nandi uses the AWS identity from your own AWS config: SSO, a profile, or a Bedrock API key in your environment. Agents use it too when there’s no access key below.
settings.cloud.accessKeyHint: Kept in your system keychain. Agents’ AWS calls go through Nandi, which signs them with this key. Without a key, agents use the sign-in above. Each agent can also use its own profile, chosen in its settings.
settings.cloud.removeConfirm.title: Remove the AWS access key?
settings.cloud.removeConfirm.description: Agents that call AWS (for example S3) will use the sign-in above instead, or stop working if there’s none.
settings.internet.description: What agents can reach. Agents run in containers and reach the internet only through Nandi, and only the sites their settings allow.
settings.internet.proxyDown: Agents can’t reach the internet right now.
settings.sources.empty: No sources. The Library has nothing to browse.
settings.sources.removeDescription: The Library stops showing what it offers. Anything you installed from it stays installed.

errors.offline: Couldn’t reach it. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: It took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.notFound: It wasn’t found. Check the name or address.
errors.auth: Sign-in is needed, or the key or token didn’t work.
errors.permission: You don’t have access to that.
errors.invalid: Something in it isn’t right. Open Details to see what.
errors.busy: It’s busy right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.relayUnavailable: This needs your company’s relay. Connect to it in Network › Connection.
errors.peerKeyChanged: Their key changed. Open their profile, check the new key with them and accept it to send again.
errors.peerKeyMissing: They haven’t set up their keys yet, so nothing can be sent to them privately. Ask them to update Nandi and connect to the relay.
errors.sealRefused: Something they sent couldn’t be verified, so Nandi didn’t use it. If their key changed, check it on their profile.
errors.envelopeTooLarge: This is too big to send to another person. Share files as links instead.
errors.other: Something went wrong. Open Details for what happened.

notes.editorPlaceholder: Write in Markdown: # headings, - lists, | tables |

triggers.calendar.timesHint: 24-hour local time, like 09:00. Separate several with commas.
triggers.calendar.skipDatesHint: Holidays when it doesn't run, as YYYY-MM-DD.
triggers.calendar.whoHint: Optional. Use the names people have on the network. The agent gets today's person as {{payload.responsible}}. Put the same trigger in everyone's Nandi and each one runs only on its owner's days.
triggers.calendar.backupHint: Takes over when the responsible person's run fails, runs late, or their Nandi is off.
triggers.calendar.backupAfterHint: Leave empty to hand over only when the run fails or never starts.
triggers.calendar.byDayHint: Someone who always has a weekday. This comes before taking turns.
triggers.calendar.coverHint: For holidays and swaps. A stand-in comes before everything else on those dates.
triggers.calendar.noRuns: Nothing is scheduled in the next year.
